theorems.name: transition_total
theorems.doc: No command panics, for any actor and state.
theorems.statement:
theorem transition_total (a : Device) (s : OtaState) (c : Command) :
    ∃ r, transition a s c = ok r
theorems.proof:
theorem transition_total (a : Device) (s : OtaState) (c : Command) :
    ∃ r, transition a s c = ok r := by
  have h : transition a s c ⦃ _ => True ⦄ := by
    unfold transition
    cases c <;> step* <;> scalar_tac
  exact H5iAppLib.ok_of h

theorems.name: sound
theorems.doc: Every accepted read-only command writes nothing, for all actors/states.
theorems.statement:
theorem sound (a : Device) (s : OtaState) (c : Command) (ws : Option OtaState) (r : Reply)
    (hro : read_only c = ok true) (ht : transition a s c = ok (.Ok (ws, r))) : ws = none
theorems.proof:
theorem sound (a : Device) (s : OtaState) (c : Command) (ws : Option OtaState) (r : Reply)
    (hro : read_only c = ok true) (ht : transition a s c = ok (.Ok (ws, r))) : ws = none := by
  cases c <;> simp_all [read_only, transition]

theorems.name: write_bounded
theorems.doc: A committed chunk never pushes the cursor past the declared image size.
theorems.statement:
theorem write_bounded (a : Device) (s : OtaState) (offset len : U32) (io : Bool) (n : OtaState) (r : Reply)
    (h : transition a s (.Write offset len io) = ok (.Ok (some n, r))) :
    n.written.val ≤ s.total.val
theorems.proof:
theorem write_bounded (a : Device) (s : OtaState) (offset len : U32) (io : Bool) (n : OtaState) (r : Reply)
    (h : transition a s (.Write offset len io) = ok (.Ok (some n, r))) :
    n.written.val ≤ s.total.val := by
  have H := H5iAppLib.post_of_ok (transition_wp a s (.Write offset len io)) h (some n) r rfl
  simp only [PostOk] at H
  simp_all

theorems.name: write_sequential
theorems.doc: A committed chunk writes exactly at the cursor and advances it by its length: writes are strictly sequential.
theorems.statement:
theorem write_sequential (a : Device) (s : OtaState) (offset len : U32) (n : OtaState) (r : Reply)
    (h : transition a s (.Write offset len true) = ok (.Ok (some n, r))) :
    offset = s.written ∧ n.written.val = s.written.val + len.val
theorems.proof:
theorem write_sequential (a : Device) (s : OtaState) (offset len : U32) (n : OtaState) (r : Reply)
    (h : transition a s (.Write offset len true) = ok (.Ok (some n, r))) :
    offset = s.written ∧ n.written.val = s.written.val + len.val := by
  have H := H5iAppLib.post_of_ok (transition_wp a s (.Write offset len true)) h (some n) r rfl
  simp only [PostOk] at H
  simp_all

theorems.name: end_integrity
theorems.doc: `end` activates a new image only when it is complete, has the ESP image magic, and matches the declared CRC.
theorems.statement:
theorem end_integrity (a : Device) (s : OtaState) (ec ac : U32) (mo ro ao : Bool) (n : OtaState) (r : Reply)
    (h : transition a s (.End ec ac mo ro ao) = ok (.Ok (some n, r))) (hclean : n.error = false) :
    s.written = s.total ∧ ro = true ∧ mo = true ∧ ac = ec ∧ ao = true
theorems.proof:
theorem end_integrity (a : Device) (s : OtaState) (ec ac : U32) (mo ro ao : Bool) (n : OtaState) (r : Reply)
    (h : transition a s (.End ec ac mo ro ao) = ok (.Ok (some n, r))) (hclean : n.error = false) :
    s.written = s.total ∧ ro = true ∧ mo = true ∧ ac = ec ∧ ao = true := by
  have H := H5iAppLib.post_of_ok (transition_wp a s (.End ec ac mo ro ao)) h (some n) r rfl
  simp only [PostOk] at H
  simp_all

theorems.name: end_failure_closes
theorems.doc: A failed verification (read-back, magic, CRC or activation) closes the session with the error set: the device never keeps accepting chunks into an image that failed, and never reports it as activated.
theorems.statement:
theorem end_failure_closes (a : Device) (s : OtaState) (ec ac : U32) (mo ro ao : Bool) (n : OtaState) (r : Reply)
    (h : transition a s (.End ec ac mo ro ao) = ok (.Ok (some n, r)))
    (hfail : ¬ (ro = true ∧ mo = true ∧ ac = ec ∧ ao = true)) :
    n.active = false ∧ n.error = true
theorems.proof:
theorem end_failure_closes (a : Device) (s : OtaState) (ec ac : U32) (mo ro ao : Bool) (n : OtaState) (r : Reply)
    (h : transition a s (.End ec ac mo ro ao) = ok (.Ok (some n, r)))
    (hfail : ¬ (ro = true ∧ mo = true ∧ ac = ec ∧ ao = true)) :
    n.active = false ∧ n.error = true := by
  have H := H5iAppLib.post_of_ok (transition_wp a s (.End ec ac mo ro ao)) h (some n) r rfl
  simp only [PostOk] at H
  refine ⟨H.2.1, ?_⟩
  cases he : n.error
  · exact absurd (H.2.2.2.2.1 he) hfail
  · rfl

theorems.name: write_io_failure_poisons
theorems.doc: A chunk whose flash write failed is not counted: the cursor does not move and the session is poisoned (later writes are refused). Rules out a port that commits the chunk before its IO succeeded -- the divergence the Renode equivalence run found in the first version of this kernel.
theorems.statement:
theorem write_io_failure_poisons (a : Device) (s : OtaState) (offset len : U32) (n : OtaState) (r : Reply)
    (h : transition a s (.Write offset len false) = ok (.Ok (some n, r))) :
    n.written = s.written ∧ n.error = true
theorems.proof:
theorem write_io_failure_poisons (a : Device) (s : OtaState) (offset len : U32) (n : OtaState) (r : Reply)
    (h : transition a s (.Write offset len false) = ok (.Ok (some n, r))) :
    n.written = s.written ∧ n.error = true := by
  have H := H5iAppLib.post_of_ok (transition_wp a s (.Write offset len false)) h (some n) r rfl
  simp only [PostOk] at H
  simp_all

theorems.name: begin_targets_other_slot
theorems.doc: `begin` never targets the running slot (it writes the inactive one).
theorems.statement:
theorem begin_targets_other_slot (a : Device) (s : OtaState) (size : U32) (n : OtaState) (r : Reply)
    (h : transition a s (.Begin size) = ok (.Ok (some n, r))) :
    n.target_slot ≠ n.running_slot ∧ n.running_slot.val ≤ 1
theorems.proof:
theorem begin_targets_other_slot (a : Device) (s : OtaState) (size : U32) (n : OtaState) (r : Reply)
    (h : transition a s (.Begin size) = ok (.Ok (some n, r))) :
    n.target_slot ≠ n.running_slot ∧ n.running_slot.val ≤ 1 := by
  have H := H5iAppLib.post_of_ok (transition_wp a s (.Begin size)) h (some n) r rfl
  simp only [PostOk] at H
  exact ⟨H.1, H.2.1⟩

theorems.name: mutating_needs_admin
theorems.doc: Every mutating OTA command is refused without the admin actor.
theorems.statement:
theorem mutating_needs_admin (a : Device) (s : OtaState) (c : Command) (ha : a.admin = false)
    (hmut : read_only c = ok false) (ws : Option OtaState) (r : Reply)
    (h : transition a s c = ok (.Ok (ws, r))) : False
theorems.proof:
theorem mutating_needs_admin (a : Device) (s : OtaState) (c : Command) (ha : a.admin = false)
    (hmut : read_only c = ok false) (ws : Option OtaState) (r : Reply)
    (h : transition a s c = ok (.Ok (ws, r))) : False := by
  cases c <;> (simp only [read_only] at hmut; unfold transition at h; simp_all)

-- --- Finding (F): no firmware authenticity, only a client-supplied CRC ---

theorems.name: inv_reachable
theorems.doc: The invariant holds in every reachable state, after any sequence of commands from any actors, successful or refused.
theorems.proof:
theorem inv_reachable {st : OtaState}
    {evs : List (H5iAppLib.Event Device Command Reply Error)}
    (h : H5iAppLib.Run transition id applyW OTA_INITIAL st evs) : Inv st :=
  H5iAppLib.Run.inv Inv inv_initial (fun a s c ws r hs ht => inv_step a s c ws r hs ht) h

theorems.name: end_accepts_any_matching_crc
theorems.doc: For *any* fully-written session and *any* image CRC, `end` succeeds when the declared CRC equals the (client-chosen) image CRC and the magic byte is present. The only integrity gate is a value the uploader controls: there is no signature / authenticity check (CWE-347).
theorems.statement:
theorem end_accepts_any_matching_crc (s : OtaState) (crc : U32)
    (hactive : s.active = true) (hdone : s.written = s.total) :
    ∃ n r, transition { admin := true } s (.End crc crc true true true) = ok (.Ok (some n, r))
      ∧ n.active = false ∧ n.error = false
theorems.proof:
theorem end_accepts_any_matching_crc (s : OtaState) (crc : U32)
    (hactive : s.active = true) (hdone : s.written = s.total) :
    ∃ n r, transition { admin := true } s (.End crc crc true true true) = ok (.Ok (some n, r))
      ∧ n.active = false ∧ n.error = false := by
  refine ⟨{ s with active := false, error := false },
          Reply.State { s with active := false, error := false }, ?_, rfl, rfl⟩
  unfold transition
  simp [hactive, hdone]

-- --- Reachability invariant over a whole run ---

theorems.name: check_auth_total
theorems.statement:
theorem check_auth_total
    (cfg : AuthCfg) (store : SessionStore) (now : U32) (cp : Bool) (ct : Array U8 8#usize)
    (bp bm ahp ahm aqp aqm dok https health : Bool) :
    ∃ r, check_auth cfg store now cp ct bp bm ahp ahm aqp aqm dok https health = ok r
theorems.proof:
theorem check_auth_total
    (cfg : AuthCfg) (store : SessionStore) (now : U32) (cp : Bool) (ct : Array U8 8#usize)
    (bp bm ahp ahm aqp aqm dok https health : Bool) :
    ∃ r, check_auth cfg store now cp ct bp bm ahp ahm aqp aqm dok https health = ok r := by
  have h : check_auth cfg store now cp ct bp bm ahp ahm aqp aqm dok https health ⦃ _ => True ⦄ := by
    unfold check_auth
    step*
  exact H5iAppLib.ok_of h

theorems.name: validate_session_sound
theorems.doc: If `validate_session` accepts a token then some slot accepts it.
theorems.statement:
theorem validate_session_sound (store : SessionStore) (token : Array U8 8#usize) (now : U32)
    (h : validate_session store token now = ok true) :
    slot_valid store.s0 token now = ok true ∨ slot_valid store.s1 token now = ok true
      ∨ slot_valid store.s2 token now = ok true ∨ slot_valid store.s3 token now = ok true
theorems.proof:
theorem validate_session_sound (store : SessionStore) (token : Array U8 8#usize) (now : U32)
    (h : validate_session store token now = ok true) :
    slot_valid store.s0 token now = ok true ∨ slot_valid store.s1 token now = ok true
      ∨ slot_valid store.s2 token now = ok true ∨ slot_valid store.s3 token now = ok true := by
  unfold validate_session at h
  rw [H5iAppLib.bind_eq_ok] at h
  obtain ⟨b0, hb0, h⟩ := h
  cases b0
  · simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, if_false] at h
    rw [H5iAppLib.bind_eq_ok] at h
    obtain ⟨b1, hb1, h⟩ := h
    cases b1
    · simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, if_false] at h
      rw [H5iAppLib.bind_eq_ok] at h
      obtain ⟨b2, hb2, h⟩ := h
      cases b2
      · simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, if_false] at h
        exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr h))
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl hb2))
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inl hb1)
  · exact Or.inl hb0

theorems.name: slot_valid_fresh
theorems.doc: SECURITY (S): a slot accepts a token only while it is within its TTL — `slot_valid` genuinely checks `age_ok`. Kills a kernel that drops the expiry check.
theorems.statement:
theorem slot_valid_fresh (slot : SessionSlot) (token : Array U8 8#usize) (now : U32)
    (h : slot_valid slot token now = ok true) : age_ok now slot.created = ok true
theorems.proof:
theorem slot_valid_fresh (slot : SessionSlot) (token : Array U8 8#usize) (now : U32)
    (h : slot_valid slot token now = ok true) : age_ok now slot.created = ok true := by
  unfold slot_valid at h
  rw [H5iAppLib.bind_eq_ok] at h
  obtain ⟨b, _hb, h⟩ := h
  cases b
  case false => simp at h
  case true =>
    simp only [reduceIte] at h
    rw [H5iAppLib.bind_eq_ok] at h
    obtain ⟨b1, _hb1, h⟩ := h
    cases b1
    case false => simpa using h
    case true => simp at h

theorems.name: unauth_never_granted
theorems.doc: SECURITY (S): with `public_access` off, a non-health request that carries no valid credential is never granted (refused with `Forbidden` or `Challenge`).
theorems.statement:
theorem unauth_never_granted
    (cfg : AuthCfg) (store : SessionStore) (now : U32) (cp : Bool) (ct : Array U8 8#usize)
    (bp bm ahp ahm aqp aqm https : Bool)
    (hpub : cfg.public_access = false)
    (hcookie : cp = true → validate_session store ct now = ok false)
    (hbearer : ¬ (bp = true ∧ cfg.bearer_set = true ∧ bm = true))
    (hakh : ¬ (ahp = true ∧ cfg.apikey_set = true ∧ ahm = true))
    (hakq : ¬ (aqp = true ∧ cfg.apikey_set = true ∧ aqm = true)) :
    ∃ r, check_auth cfg store now cp ct bp bm ahp ahm aqp aqm false https false = ok r
      ∧ ¬ granted r
theorems.proof:
theorem unauth_never_granted
    (cfg : AuthCfg) (store : SessionStore) (now : U32) (cp : Bool) (ct : Array U8 8#usize)
    (bp bm ahp ahm aqp aqm https : Bool)
    (hpub : cfg.public_access = false)
    (hcookie : cp = true → validate_session store ct now = ok false)
    (hbearer : ¬ (bp = true ∧ cfg.bearer_set = true ∧ bm = true))
    (hakh : ¬ (ahp = true ∧ cfg.apikey_set = true ∧ ahm = true))
    (hakq : ¬ (aqp = true ∧ cfg.apikey_set = true ∧ aqm = true)) :
    ∃ r, check_auth cfg store now cp ct bp bm ahp ahm aqp aqm false https false = ok r
      ∧ ¬ granted r := by
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := check_auth_total cfg store now cp ct bp bm ahp ahm aqp aqm false https false
  refine ⟨r, hr, ?_⟩
  have hspec : check_auth cfg store now cp ct bp bm ahp ahm aqp aqm false https false
      ⦃ x => ¬ granted x ⦄ := by
    unfold check_auth transport_blocks granted
    by_cases hc : cp = true
    · rw [hcookie hc]
      step* <;> simp_all
    · simp only [Bool.not_eq_true] at hc
      step* <;> simp_all
  exact H5iAppLib.post_of_ok (P := fun x => ¬ granted x) hspec hr

theorems.name: token_over_http_forbidden
theorems.doc: SECURITY (S): a bearer token or API key presented over plaintext HTTP, with token-over-HTTP disabled and no valid session cookie, is refused.
theorems.statement:
theorem token_over_http_forbidden
    (cfg : AuthCfg) (store : SessionStore) (now : U32) (cp : Bool) (ct : Array U8 8#usize)
    (bp bm ahp ahm aqp aqm dok health : Bool)
    (hpub : cfg.public_access = false) (hhealth : health = false)
    (hhttp : cfg.allow_http_tokens = false)
    (hcookie : validate_session store ct now = ok false)
    (htok : bp = true ∨ ahp = true ∨ aqp = true) :
    check_auth cfg store now cp ct bp bm ahp ahm aqp aqm dok false health
      = ok AuthDecision.Forbidden
theorems.proof:
theorem token_over_http_forbidden
    (cfg : AuthCfg) (store : SessionStore) (now : U32) (cp : Bool) (ct : Array U8 8#usize)
    (bp bm ahp ahm aqp aqm dok health : Bool)
    (hpub : cfg.public_access = false) (hhealth : health = false)
    (hhttp : cfg.allow_http_tokens = false)
    (hcookie : validate_session store ct now = ok false)
    (htok : bp = true ∨ ahp = true ∨ aqp = true) :
    check_auth cfg store now cp ct bp bm ahp ahm aqp aqm dok false health
      = ok AuthDecision.Forbidden := by
  apply H5iAppLib.eq_ok_of_spec
  show check_auth cfg store now cp ct bp bm ahp ahm aqp aqm dok false health
      ⦃ r => r = AuthDecision.Forbidden ⦄
  unfold check_auth transport_blocks
  rw [hcookie]
  rcases htok with hb | hah | haq <;> step* <;> simp_all

theorems.name: expired_session_never_grants
theorems.doc: SECURITY (S): an expired session cookie never grants access.
theorems.statement:
theorem expired_session_never_grants
    (cfg : AuthCfg) (store : SessionStore) (token : Array U8 8#usize) (now : U32)
    (hpub : cfg.public_access = false)
    (hexp : validate_session store token now = ok false) :
    check_auth cfg store now true token false false false false false false false true false
      = ok AuthDecision.Challenge
theorems.proof:
theorem expired_session_never_grants
    (cfg : AuthCfg) (store : SessionStore) (token : Array U8 8#usize) (now : U32)
    (hpub : cfg.public_access = false)
    (hexp : validate_session store token now = ok false) :
    check_auth cfg store now true token false false false false false false false true false
      = ok AuthDecision.Challenge := by
  apply H5iAppLib.eq_ok_of_spec
  show check_auth cfg store now true token false false false false false false false true false
      ⦃ r => r = AuthDecision.Challenge ⦄
  unfold check_auth transport_blocks
  rw [hexp]
  step* <;> simp_all

theorems.name: empty_secret_no_bypass
theorems.doc: SECURITY (S): an unset bearer token / API key never grants access, even if the (empty) comparison reported a match.
theorems.statement:
theorem empty_secret_no_bypass
    (cfg : AuthCfg) (store : SessionStore) (now : U32) (ct : Array U8 8#usize)
    (bm ahm aqm : Bool)
    (hpub : cfg.public_access = false)
    (hbset : cfg.bearer_set = false) (haset : cfg.apikey_set = false) :
    ∃ r, check_auth cfg store now false ct true bm true ahm true aqm false true false = ok r
      ∧ r ≠ AuthDecision.Allowed
theorems.proof:
theorem empty_secret_no_bypass
    (cfg : AuthCfg) (store : SessionStore) (now : U32) (ct : Array U8 8#usize)
    (bm ahm aqm : Bool)
    (hpub : cfg.public_access = false)
    (hbset : cfg.bearer_set = false) (haset : cfg.apikey_set = false) :
    ∃ r, check_auth cfg store now false ct true bm true ahm true aqm false true false = ok r
      ∧ r ≠ AuthDecision.Allowed := by
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := check_auth_total cfg store now false ct true bm true ahm true aqm false true false
  refine ⟨r, hr, ?_⟩
  have hspec : check_auth cfg store now false ct true bm true ahm true aqm false true false
      ⦃ x => x ≠ AuthDecision.Allowed ⦄ := by
    unfold check_auth transport_blocks
    step* <;> simp_all
  exact H5iAppLib.post_of_ok (P := fun x => x ≠ AuthDecision.Allowed) hspec hr

theorems.name: public_access_opens_everything
theorems.doc: FINDING (F): `public_access` (the shipped default) grants every request with no credential at all.
theorems.statement:
theorem public_access_opens_everything
    (store : SessionStore) (now : U32) (cp : Bool) (ct : Array U8 8#usize)
    (bp bm ahp ahm aqp aqm dok https health : Bool)
    (cfg : AuthCfg) (hpub : cfg.public_access = true) :
    check_auth cfg store now cp ct bp bm ahp ahm aqp aqm dok https health = ok AuthDecision.Allowed
theorems.proof:
theorem public_access_opens_everything
    (store : SessionStore) (now : U32) (cp : Bool) (ct : Array U8 8#usize)
    (bp bm ahp ahm aqp aqm dok https health : Bool)
    (cfg : AuthCfg) (hpub : cfg.public_access = true) :
    check_auth cfg store now cp ct bp bm ahp ahm aqp aqm dok https health = ok AuthDecision.Allowed := by
  apply H5iAppLib.eq_ok_of_spec
  show check_auth cfg store now cp ct bp bm ahp ahm aqp aqm dok https health
      ⦃ r => r = AuthDecision.Allowed ⦄
  unfold check_auth
  step* <;> simp_all

slot_valid.lean:
def slot_valid
  (slot : SessionSlot) (token : Array Std.U8 8#usize) (now : Std.U32) :
  Result Bool
  := do
  let b ← ct_eq8 slot.token token
  if b
  then
    let b1 ← is_zero8 slot.token
    if b1
    then ok false
    else age_ok now slot.created
  else ok false
slot_valid.upstream_note: the per-slot predicate passed to sessions.iter().any in validate_session

check_auth.lean:
def check_auth
  (cfg : AuthCfg) (store : SessionStore) (now : Std.U32)
  (cookie_present : Bool) (cookie_token : Array Std.U8 8#usize)
  (bearer_present : Bool) (bearer_match : Bool) (akh_present : Bool)
  (akh_match : Bool) (akq_present : Bool) (akq_match : Bool) (digest_ok : Bool)
  (is_https : Bool) (is_health : Bool) :
  Result AuthDecision
  := do
  let blocked ← transport_blocks is_https cfg.allow_http_tokens
  let vs ← validate_session store cookie_token now
  if cfg.public_access
  then ok AuthDecision.Allowed
  else
    if is_health
    then ok AuthDecision.Allowed
    else
      if cookie_present && vs
      then ok AuthDecision.Allowed
      else
        if bearer_present && blocked
        then ok AuthDecision.Forbidden
        else
          if (bearer_present && cfg.bearer_set) && bearer_match
          then ok AuthDecision.Allowed
          else
            if akh_present && blocked
            then ok AuthDecision.Forbidden
            else
              if (akh_present && cfg.apikey_set) && akh_match
              then ok AuthDecision.Allowed
              else
                if akq_present && blocked
                then ok AuthDecision.Forbidden
                else
                  if (akq_present && cfg.apikey_set) && akq_match
                  then ok AuthDecision.Allowed
                  else
                    if digest_ok
                    then ok AuthDecision.AllowedSetSession
                    else ok AuthDecision.Challenge
check_auth.upstream_note: nested check_auth flattened; header parsing, cookie decryption, MD5 and comparisons are trusted inputs

transition.lean:
def transition
  (actor : Device) (s : OtaState) (cmd : Command) :
  Result (core.result.Result ((Option OtaState) × Reply) Error)
  := do
  match cmd with
  | Command.Begin size =>
    if actor.admin
    then
      if s.active
      then ok (core.result.Result.Err Error.AlreadyActive)
      else
        if size = 0#u32
        then ok (core.result.Result.Err Error.BadSize)
        else
          if size > OTA_SLOT_SIZE
          then ok (core.result.Result.Err Error.BadSize)
          else
            if s.running_slot > 1#u8
            then ok (core.result.Result.Err Error.RunningUnknown)
            else
              let target ← 1#u8 - s.running_slot
              ok (core.result.Result.Ok (some
                {
                  s
                    with
                    active := true,
                    target_slot := target,
                    total := size,
                    written := 0#u32,
                    error := false
                }, Reply.State
                {
                  s
                    with
                    active := true,
                    target_slot := target,
                    total := size,
                    written := 0#u32,
                    error := false
                }))
    else ok (core.result.Result.Err Error.Forbidden)
  | Command.Write offset len io_ok =>
    if actor.admin
    then
      if s.active
      then
        if s.error
        then ok (core.result.Result.Err Error.PriorError)
        else
          if len = 0#u32
          then ok (core.result.Result.Err Error.ChunkSize)
          else
            if len > MAX_CHUNK
            then ok (core.result.Result.Err Error.ChunkSize)
            else
              if offset < s.written
              then
                let i ← s.written - offset
                if len <= i
                then ok (core.result.Result.Ok (none, Reply.State s))
                else
                  if offset != s.written
                  then ok (core.result.Result.Err Error.OffsetMismatch)
                  else
                    if offset > s.total
                    then ok (core.result.Result.Err Error.ExceedsDeclared)
                    else
                      let i1 ← s.total - offset
                      if len > i1
                      then ok (core.result.Result.Err Error.ExceedsDeclared)
                      else
                        if io_ok
                        then
                          let new_written ← offset + len
                          ok (core.result.Result.Ok (some
                            { s with written := new_written }, Reply.State
                            { s with written := new_written }))
                        else
                          ok (core.result.Result.Ok (some
                            { s with error := true }, Reply.State
                            { s with error := true }))
              else
                if offset != s.written
                then ok (core.result.Result.Err Error.OffsetMismatch)
                else
                  if offset > s.total
                  then ok (core.result.Result.Err Error.ExceedsDeclared)
                  else
                    let i ← s.total - offset
                    if len > i
                    then ok (core.result.Result.Err Error.ExceedsDeclared)
                    else
                      if io_ok
                      then
                        let new_written ← offset + len
                        ok (core.result.Result.Ok (some
                          { s with written := new_written }, Reply.State
                          { s with written := new_written }))
                      else
                        ok (core.result.Result.Ok (some
                          { s with error := true }, Reply.State
                          { s with error := true }))
      else ok (core.result.Result.Err Error.NoSession)
    else ok (core.result.Result.Err Error.Forbidden)
  | Command.End expected_crc actual_crc magic_ok read_ok activate_ok =>
    if actor.admin
    then
      if s.active
      then
        if s.written != s.total
        then ok (core.result.Result.Err Error.Incomplete)
        else
          ok (core.result.Result.Ok (some
            {
              s
                with
                active := false,
                error :=
                  (¬
                    (((read_ok
                    &&
                    magic_ok)
                    &&
                    (actual_crc
                    =
                    expected_crc))
                    &&
                    activate_ok))
            }, Reply.State
            {
              s
                with
                active := false,
                error :=
                  (¬
                    (((read_ok
                    &&
                    magic_ok)
                    &&
                    (actual_crc
                    =
                    expected_crc))
                    &&
                    activate_ok))
            }))
      else ok (core.result.Result.Err Error.NoSession)
    else ok (core.result.Result.Err Error.Forbidden)
  | Command.Abort =>
    if actor.admin
    then
      if s.active
      then
        ok (core.result.Result.Ok (some
          { s with active := false, written := 0#u32, error := false },
          Reply.State
          { s with active := false, written := 0#u32, error := false }))
      else ok (core.result.Result.Err Error.NoSession)
    else ok (core.result.Result.Err Error.Forbidden)
  | Command.Status => ok (core.result.Result.Ok (none, Reply.State s))
transition.upstream_note: begin/write/end/abort/status flattened into one pure transition; flash IO results are inputs

validate_session.lean:
def validate_session
  (store : SessionStore) (token : Array Std.U8 8#usize) (now : Std.U32) :
  Result Bool
  := do
  let b ← slot_valid store.s0 token now
  if b
  then ok true
  else
    let b1 ← slot_valid store.s1 token now
    if b1
    then ok true
    else
      let b2 ← slot_valid store.s2 token now
      if b2
      then ok true
      else slot_valid store.s3 token now
validate_session.upstream_note: now and the store are parameters instead of now_secs() and the SESSIONS static

read_only.lean:
def read_only (cmd : Command) : Result Bool := do
  match cmd with
  | Command.Begin _ => ok false
  | Command.Write _ _ _ => ok false
  | Command.End _ _ _ _ _ => ok false
  | Command.Abort => ok false
  | Command.Status => ok true
read_only.upstream_note: port-only harness predicate (Status writes no state); upstream has no command classifier

age_ok.lean:
def age_ok (now : Std.U32) (created : Std.U32) : Result Bool := do
  if now >= created
  then let i ← now - created
       ok (i <= SESSION_TTL_SECS)
  else ok false

Inv.code:
/-- The reachability safety invariant: while an OTA session is active, the
write cursor never exceeds the declared image size. (`begin` always targets
the non-running slot is the separate single-step theorem above.) -/
def Inv (s : OtaState) : Prop :=
  s.active = true → s.written.val ≤ s.total.val
